<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_NewHire" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/new-hire">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OfferAccepted" name="Offer accepted"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_NewHire" name="New Hire Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_NewHire">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HiringDepartment" name="Hiring Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_NeedIdentified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideTraining</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConfirmIntegration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OnboardingComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="HR">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateJobDescription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PostJobDescription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectResumes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ScreenResumes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PhoneInterviews</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InviteCandidates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InterviewFormatSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InPersonInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_VirtualInterview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InterviewFormatJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCandidate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExtendOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_NegotiationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NegotiateSalary</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_NegotiationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompletePaperwork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConductOrientation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Candidate" name="Candidate">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseInterviewFormat</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_OfferAccepted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" name="New hire need identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateJobDescription" name="Create job description">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostJobDescription" name="Post job description on job boards">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectResumes" name="Collect resumes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ScreenResumes" name="Screen resumes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PhoneInterviews" name="Conduct initial phone interviews">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InviteCandidates" name="Invite selected candidates for interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseInterviewFormat" name="Choose in-person or virtual interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewFormatSplit" name="Interview format?" default="Flow_10">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InPersonInterview" name="Conduct in-person interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewFormatJoin" name="Interview completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCandidate" name="Select candidate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExtendOffer" name="Extend offer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NegotiationSplit" name="Salary negotiation needed?" default="Flow_17">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateSalary" name="Negotiate salary">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NegotiationJoin" name="Offer terms settled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OfferAccepted" name="Offer accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OfferAccepted" messageRef="Msg_OfferAccepted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompletePaperwork" name="Complete onboarding paperwork">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductOrientation" name="Conduct orientation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmIntegration" name="Confirm new hire is fully integrated into team">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_23</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_24</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OnboardingComplete" name="Onboarding completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_24</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_CreateJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" targetRef="Task_PostJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_PostJobDescription" targetRef="Task_CollectResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CollectResumes" targetRef="Task_ScreenResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_ScreenResumes" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_PhoneInterviews" targetRef="Task_InviteCandidates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidates" targetRef="Task_ChooseInterviewFormat"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_ChooseInterviewFormat" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewFormatSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormatSplit" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${interviewFormat == 'inPerson'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormatSplit" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_InPersonInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewFormatJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewFormatJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormatJoin" targetRef="Task_SelectCandidate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_SelectCandidate" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateSalary">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${salaryNegotiationRequired == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateSalary" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationJoin" targetRef="Event_OfferAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Event_OfferAccepted" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" targetRef="Task_ConductOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_ConductOrientation" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Task_ConfirmIntegration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmIntegration" targetRef="EndEvent_OnboardingComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
